summary: CRM built for Google Workspace users to manage contacts, leads, opportunities, and projects.
access_note: No free plan; paid plans start at Basic with a free trial. API keys are generated in System settings by users (admins can see all keys); OAuth requires contacting Copper to register the app.
blocker_note: OAuth2 requires contacting Copper to register the app; API keys are admin-only and need a paid account.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0
Start free, no credit card required.
To register your application, contact us
provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to access most Copper resources.
Copper is launching an official MCP server, built and hosted by Copper. The beta launches in November 2026.

notes: Copper's own MCP page says an official Copper-built-and-hosted MCP server is coming, with a beta launching in November 2026, and shows a waitlist form; it is not published yet. Third-party servers exist (e.g. cotlet.dev in the MCP registry) but were not judged to have real usage. Trial length and whether the API is open during the trial could not be confirmed.

review.reason: Pricing page lists only paid plans (Basic from $29 per seat) with 'Start free, no credit card required' trials; no free plan. Trial length not stated.
